messages:
zoe: hey team, day 3 and stuck — getting 403 when trying to view project 'redwood-eu-ml' billing and the AWS assume-role flow to acct 123456789012 fails. who should I ping for billing links and cross-account role access? also need eu-west-1 quotas to run a small training job. @ashish?
ashish: welcome! short checklist: 1) gcp billing association, 2) project IAM bindings (billing.user / resourcemanager), 3) okta group -> aws cross-account role mapping. i'll loop folks. what's your okta email?
zoe: zoe.kim@redwood.dev — thanks. project id is redwood-eu-ml-01. i tried the Console and got a 403 on Billing page.
marie: hi @zoe — finance here. i can check billing associations. i don't see redwood-eu-ml-01 linked to a billing account yet. did anyone request linking during project creation?
sam: hey — cloud-ops. Zoe, can you paste the output of this command?
```
 gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-eu-ml-01 --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/billing.user")'
```
zoe: ran it, got no output (empty).
ashish: that matches: no billing.user binding. @marie can you attach the existing EU billing account to redwood-eu-ml-01? cloud-ops, please also verify Zoe has project/get + serviceusage.services.enable so she can provision things after linkage.
cloud-ops: opening ticket now — CR-2048 — adding billing linkage request. also we need Zoe added to okta group redwood-devs-eu to grant AWS cross-account role mapping. @marie i'll add billing link request to CR-2048.
marie: approved and linked the project to billing-account: 0000-AAA-BBB. Zoe, refresh the Console — you should see the billing page now.
zoe: refreshed — billing page loads! thanks :tada: still failing to assume role in AWS though (sts:AssumeRole returns AccessDenied).
sam: for AWS assume-role, common causes: (1) role trust policy doesn't include your SAML provider / group, (2) your Okta assertion mapping missing the role arn. I'll check the role trust policy and the Okta app config.
cloud-ops: checked okta mapping — Zoe was not yet in redwood-devs-eu, so no role in SAML assertion. i added zoe.kim@redwood.dev to group and force-synced to AWS. try again.
zoe: trying... now I can assume arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodCrossAccountDev — success! :white_check_mark:
ashish: great. last bit — quotas. for your training job, which resources do you need? GPUs/GPUs vCPUs? specify region/zone and instance types.
zoe: target is eu-west-1, 4x a100, ~64 vCPUs.
sam: file a request in cloud-requests with region=eu-west-1, resource=GPU (a100), desired=4, justification=test cluster for onboarding. we'll coordinate with cloud provider to bump quotas. I'll reference CR-2048 so we keep it in one place.
zoe: filed ticket now with details and benchmark link. thanks everyone — this unblocks my first experiment.
ashish: welcome aboard, Zoe — tagging infra playbook: add yourself to the onboarding doc (docs/onboarding/cloud-access.md) and follow up with cloud-ops if you need networking / VPC peering for datasets.
marie: finance note: if you spin up large GPU infra, ping me for cost center tagging — we can set spend alerts.
zoe: will do. closing this thread — feel free to reopen if quota request needs more info. thanks all :)
